host_rules: Register exactly the host-selected observable obligation with an existing approved event/beat reference.
Registration status is explicitly pre-registered; execution or cancellation is not generation.
Target chapter must match the supplied approved target outline; unknown future targets are not invented.
Post-ship fulfillment evidence must bind the exact ACK, current prose hash, complete obligation quotes and ship receipt.
Fulfillment evidence validation does not mutate the ACK or authenticate the ship issuer.
